Maya (eng-platform): heads up — a customer hit a weird resume case with SSE where the client reconnects, we resume the stream, but traffic routing flips to a different model variant and they got billed twice for the same conversation :facepalm:
Kai (eng-runtime): ugh. do we have a repro or logs? is it the resume id mismatch or a proxy sticky-session loss?
Maya (eng-platform): repro attached. gist link in DM. root cause seems to be: on reconnect we accept resume with x-resume-id, but the smart-router picks target based on current policy and not the original route. short logs:
```
[2026-03-10T14:02:11Z] conn resume: resume_id=abc123; session_shard=shard-7
[2026-03-10T14:02:11Z] router eval: policy=cost_prefer; selected=redwood-7-quant
[2026-03-10T14:02:11Z] session restore: pinned=redwood-9-fp16
[2026-03-10T14:02:11Z] billing: start new invoice segment for request_id=xyz789
```
Kai (eng-runtime): hmm router eval shouldn't change on resume. we intentionally store the original route in session metadata (route_id). are we dropping route_id on certain resume paths?
Anna (observability): telemetry shows ~0.6% of resumes in the last 72h had route_id=null. spike correlates with our new ingress proxy rollout.
Sam (sre): sounds like ingress proxy version v2.14 did a streaming handshake change last week. deploy-bot shows it rolled to 30% of edge nodes on 2026-03-09 22:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: deployment v2.14 -> edge-proxy cluster-delta applied to node-group:edge-ptx (30%) :rocket:
Lucy (product): customer impact? duplicates billing is high friction — do we have a safe rollback or a mitigation?
Maya (eng-platform): mitigation idea: on resume, check for route_id mismatch; if mismatch, force fallback to the pinned route and mark resume as safe-resume=false in telemetry, and return a resume_status header to client so SDKs can surface "resumed on different variant".
Kai (eng-runtime): implementation details: when resuming, read x-session-meta (route_id, model_sha). if router selected != route_id then we should prefer session route. but watch out for capacity — we may not have capacity in that original pool. need fallback policy: try pinned route within 500ms, else continue with selected route but mark as resumed-on-variant=true.
Anna (observability): we should also add a resume-telemetry dimension: resume_outcome={pinned_ok,pinned_unavailable,forced_switch}. add counters and traces. right now traces lack route_id on resume spans.
Sam (sre): short-term hotfix: revert proxy handshake change (v2.14) or disable the resume path that strips session meta. i'll open rollback PR if eng-platform wants to try mitigation first.
Maya (eng-platform): repro indicates pinned route was available in ~95% of cases. so mitigation seems safe, rollback might be heavy. prefer coding a 1-line guard: if route_id missing, reject resume with 409 and clear instruction to reconnect fresh. less customer-facing duplication.
Lucy (product): rejecting resumes will cause more reconnects for users with flaky mobile nets. we should avoid breaking UX. can we surface a gentle SDK-level warning and auto-fallback billing protection?
Kai (eng-runtime): billing protection is tricky — but we can detect duplicate logical session ids within a small window (10s) and dedupe billing events by original session id + resume_nonce. add a transient cache to billing pipeline. low-risk.
Anna (observability): plan: 1) add resume_outcome dimension and route_id in resume spans; 2) flag clients with resume_status header; 3) instrument billing dedupe metric. i'll make dashboards and alerts.
Sam (sre): i'll prepare rollback PR if we see >1% resume-without-route in next hour after mitigation.
Maya (eng-platform): tasks assigned: Kai implement prefer-session-route with 500ms try (PR), Anna add telemetry/dashboards, Sam hold rollback PR ready, Lucy review customer comms template. i'll file a follow-up with exact endpoints and headers.
Lucy (product): thx — also can we add a Console rollout UX tweak: show "resume risk" in per-route rollout UI so PMs can see which variants are sticky? small feature request.
Kai (eng-runtime): noted, will add a API field resume_sensitive=true to rollout configs.
Maya (eng-platform): ok let's move this to a short async RFC and ping on-call for monitor coverage. closing thread for now but will post PR links. :+1:
